learningObjective: Read an HLO fragment and identify dot / contraction semantics and elementwise add.

canonicalClaims.claim: HLO's `dot` with `lhs_contracting_dims={k}` and `rhs_contracting_dims={0}` performs matrix multiplication contracting those axes; a subsequent elementwise `add` sums two same-shape tensors; `ROOT` marks the entry computation's return value.
nonImplications: Does not imply layout is specified in this fragment.
Does not imply fusion; that is a compiler pass decision.

misconceptions.whyWrong: It is a contraction (matmul when both operands are rank-2 with single contracting dims).

misconceptions.claim: Rank-2 elementwise `add` in HLO requires broadcast to rank-3.
misconceptions.whyWrong: Same-shape rank-2 elementwise add is legal.
`ROOT` marks the output value of an HLO computation.

misconceptions.claim: HLO ops always fuse when adjacent in source order.
misconceptions.whyWrong: Fusion is a compiler pass with its own policy.

implementationFacts: `dot_general` is the general form; `dot` is the rank-2 special case.
Elementwise ops require identical shape (broadcast is a separate op).
